blocks.en: The space $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ is a Banach space. If $p<\infty$, it is separable.
blocks.zh: 空间 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 为 Banach 空间. 若 $p<\infty$, 则它可分.
blocks.label: thm:sobolev-banach-separability

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
For $u\in W^{k,p}(\Omega)$, let $u_\alpha=D^\alpha u$. Then the mapping $u\to(u_\alpha)_{|\alpha|\leq k}$ is an isometry from $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ onto a subspace $M$ of the direct product $\prod_{|\alpha|\leq k}L^p(\Omega)$. The completeness of $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ follows if we show that $M$ is closed. For this, one has to show that if $u_n\in W^{k,p}$ and $D^\alpha u_n\to v^\alpha$ in $L^p(\Omega)$, then $v^\alpha=D^\alpha v^0$. But this is clear, since $L^p$-convergence implies distributional convergence.

If $p<\infty$, then $\prod_{|\alpha|\leq k}L^p(\Omega)$ is separable. Hence we only need to show that a subspace of a separable Banach space is separable. This is done in the following lemma to complete the proof of this theorem.
blocks.zh:
对 $u\in W^{k,p}(\Omega)$, 令 $u_\alpha=D^\alpha u$. 那么映射 $u\to(u_\alpha)_{|\alpha|\leq k}$ 是从 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 到直积 $\prod_{|\alpha|\leq k}L^p(\Omega)$ 的一个子空间 $M$ 上的等距映射. 只要证明 $M$ 闭, 就得到 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 的完备性. 为此需要证明, 若 $u_n\in W^{k,p}$ 且 $D^\alpha u_n\to v^\alpha$ 在 $L^p(\Omega)$ 中成立, 则 $v^\alpha=D^\alpha v^0$. 但这显然成立, 因为 $L^p$ 收敛蕴含分布收敛.

若 $p<\infty$, 则 $\prod_{|\alpha|\leq k}L^p(\Omega)$ 可分. 因而只需证明可分 Banach 空间的子空间可分. 以下引理证明这一点, 从而完成本定理的证明.

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a separable Banach space and let $M$ be a linear subspace of $X$. Then $M$ is separable.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为可分 Banach 空间, $M$ 为 $X$ 的线性子空间. 那么 $M$ 可分.
blocks.label: lem:separable-banach-linear-subspace

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For any given $\varepsilon>0$, there is a countable set $\{x_n\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ in $X$ such that for any $x\in X$ there is $n\in\mathbb{N}$ with $\|x-x_n\|\leq\varepsilon$. From the sequence $x_n$, discard all elements such that the ball of radius $\varepsilon$ centered at $x_n$ does not intersect $M$. The remaining points form a new sequence $y_n$. Now let $u_n$ be any point in $M$ which lies in the $\varepsilon$-neighborhood of $y_n$. Then every point in $M$ lies within $\varepsilon$ of one of the $y_n$ and hence within $2\varepsilon$ of one of the $u_n$. By letting $\varepsilon$ run through any sequence that converges to zero, we can generate a countable dense set in $M$.
blocks.zh: 对任意给定的 $\varepsilon>0$, $X$ 中存在可数集 $\{x_n\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$, 使对任意 $x\in X$, 都存在 $n\in\mathbb{N}$, 满足 $\|x-x_n\|\leq\varepsilon$. 从序列 $x_n$ 中删去所有使以 $x_n$ 为中心, 半径为 $\varepsilon$ 的球与 $M$ 不相交的元素. 剩余点组成新序列 $y_n$. 现在设 $u_n$ 为 $M$ 中位于 $y_n$ 的 $\varepsilon$ 邻域内的任意点. 那么 $M$ 中每个点与某个 $y_n$ 的距离不超过 $\varepsilon$, 因而与某个 $u_n$ 的距离不超过 $2\varepsilon$. 让 $\varepsilon$ 遍历任意收敛到零的序列, 就可生成 $M$ 中的一个可数稠密集.

blocks.en: If $p<\infty$, then $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ is dense in $L^p(\Omega)$. This is generally not the case for the spaces $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$. Indeed we have the following result.
blocks.zh: 若 $p<\infty$, 则 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 在 $L^p(\Omega)$ 中稠密. 对空间 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$, 一般并非如此. 事实上有以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be bounded, let $k\geq1$ and $1\leq p\leq\infty$. Then $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ is not dense in $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 有界, $k\geq1$ 且 $1\leq p\leq\infty$. 那么 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 在 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 中不稠密.
blocks.label: lem:test-functions-sobolev-nondensity

blocks.en: By $W_0^{k,p}(\Omega)$ we denote the closure of $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ in $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 用 $W_0^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 表示 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 在 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ 中的闭包.
blocks.label: def:sobolev-test-function-closure
